verses.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ שִׁיבַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הָ֝יִ֗ינוּ כְּחֹלְמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ bə·šūḇ Yah·weh ’eṯ- šî·ḇaṯ ṣî·yō·wn hā·yî·nū kə·ḥō·lə·mîm
verses.literal: A song of ascents When the LORD restored the captives of Zion we were like dreamers
verses.literalPt: QUANDO o SENHOR trouxe do cativeiro os que voltaram a Sião, estávamos como os que sonham.

verses.original: אָ֤ז יִמָּלֵ֪א שְׂח֡וֹק פִּינוּ֮ וּלְשׁוֹנֵ֪נוּ רִ֫נָּ֥ה אָ֭ז יֹאמְר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם הִגְדִּ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִם־ אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz yim·mā·lê śə·ḥō·wq pî·nū ū·lə·šō·w·nê·nū rin·nāh ’āz yō·mə·rū ḇag·gō·w·yim hiḡ·dîl Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘im- ’êl·leh
verses.literal: Then our mouths were filled with laughter our tongues with shouts of joy Then it was said among the nations The LORD has done great things for them
verses.literalPt: Então a nossa boca se encheu de riso e a nossa língua de cântico; então se dizia entre os gentios: Grandes coisas fez o SENHOR a estes.

verses.original: הִגְדִּ֣יל יְ֭הוָה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת עִמָּ֗נוּ הָיִ֥ינוּ שְׂמֵחִֽים׃
verses.literal: The LORD has done great things for us we are filled with joy
verses.literalPt: Grandes coisas fez o SENHOR por nós, pelas quais estamos alegres.

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ שְׁבוּתֵנוּ כַּאֲפִיקִ֥ים בַּנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.literal: Restore our captives O LORD like streams in the Negev
verses.literalPt: Traze-nos outra vez, ó SENHOR, do cativeiro, como as correntes das águas no sul.

verses.literal: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy
verses.literalPt: Os que semeiam em lágrimas segarão com alegria.

verses.original: הָ֘ל֤וֹךְ יֵלֵ֨ךְ׀ וּבָכֹה֮ נֹשֵׂ֪א מֶֽשֶׁךְ־ הַ֫זָּ֥רַע בֹּֽ֬א־ יָב֥וֹא בְרִנָּ֑ה נֹ֝שֵׂ֗א אֲלֻמֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ yê·lêḵ ū·ḇā·ḵōh nō·śê me·šeḵ- haz·zā·ra‘ bō- yā·ḇō·w ḇə·rin·nāh nō·śê ’ă·lum·mō·ṯāw
verses.literal: He who goes out . . . weeping bearing a trail of seed will surely return . . . with shouts of joy carrying sheaves of grain
verses.literalPt: Aquele que leva a preciosa semente, andando e chorando, voltará, sem dúvida, com alegria, trazendo consigo os seus molhos.
